parsed.note_claim: During protests in Mexico City on Nov 15, 2025, demonstrators tore down barriers and clashed with police, but police used tear gas to maintain control.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Demonstrators dismantled parts of a barrier protecting the National Palace, where Sheinbaum lives. Police protecting the compound used tear gas on the crowds.
parsed.reason: The article confirms demonstrators dismantled barriers at the National Palace and police responded with tear gas, directly substantiating the note's specific factual claims.
